description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Byte enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Byte trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat.
